Getting There

The trailhead is at 30.54016, -102.85004 (tap for driving directions). It's roughly 230 miles east of El Paso, Texas. Arrive early on weekends — trailhead lots at popular peaks fill quickly, and cell service is often unreliable once you leave the highway.

When to Go

October through April is the comfortable window here — summer temperatures at this elevation are dangerously hot, so if you must hike in summer, start at first light and carry more water than you think you need.
